name: rt_hotel_concept
subject: make these grey Stockholm old town rooftops lovely and finished. The flat grey slabs become real buildings seen front-on: the long roof Pepper walks on is a flat tar roof with a stone parapet cap and a warm ochre plaster wall below it with evenly spaced windows; the low box marked HOTEL becomes the top floor of a grand hotel with a green copper roof edge and tall windows, without letters; the two sunken gaps are glass skylights in iron frames set into the roof; the orange bars are loose red clay roof tiles resting over the skylights; behind, a row of red tile pitched roofs, chimney stacks with clay pots and a church spire against a warm sky. Every roof is the top of a building whose wall goes down out of the frame; nothing floats

slot.where: Rooftops, the hotel roof, camera y 240 x 4224

extra: Full local colour and crisp edges, the same flat-shaded pixel style as the dog. Keep the dog, the girl, the goose, the bones and the framing exactly as they are.
